final_claim: For a three-velocity symmetric run/zero/tumble trap with rho,tau>0, joint stationary (Y,H) has an exact two-Beta/Bernoulli latent law, all-threshold strict radial stochastic orders, and P(tumble|Y=y)=(1-y²)/2+O((1-y²)²) as |y| tends to 1.
limitations: Stationary one-time annealed law only, not a pathwise latent decomposition or signed running velocity.
No external diffusion, asymmetric tumble selection or higher dimensions.
